select r.radar_id, r.tree_id, r.category_node_id, n.node_name as category_node_name, r.radar_code, r.radar_name, r.sn, r.line_count, r.detection_range, r.manufacturer, r.model_name, r.status, r.create_time, r.remark, case when b.bind_id is null then false else true end as bound, b.vehicle_id as bound_vehicle_id, v.plate_no as bound_plate_no from biz_radar r left join biz_tree_node n on n.node_id = r.category_node_id and n.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle_equipment_bind b on b.equipment_type = '2' and b.equipment_id = r.radar_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle v on v.id = b.vehicle_id and v.del_flag = 0
r.del_flag = '0' and r.status = '0' and (b.bind_id is null or b.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId})
and ( r.radar_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.radar_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or r.sn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by r.radar_code asc, r.radar_id desc

select r.radar_id, r.tree_id, r.category_node_id, n.node_name as category_node_name, r.radar_code, r.radar_name, r.sn, r.line_count, r.detection_range, r.manufacturer, r.model_name, r.status, r.create_time, r.remark from biz_radar r left join biz_tree_node n on n.node_id = r.category_node_id and n.del_flag = '0' where r.del_flag = '0' and r.radar_id in
#{radarId}
